_readme: Content for the personalized welcome kit popup. /api/welcome merges this with clients.json based on the access code. Edit freely: teams keys are finance/talent/gtm/other, countries keys are US/AR/AU/OTHER.

talent.label: Talent
how: Talent runs on embedded pods per client: you will live inside the client's team, not outside it.
Ashby is the ATS. Get oriented in week one and ask anything in #g-ashby-support.
The weekly rhythm: pipeline reviews with your client, a weekly hiring report (template in the hub), and the Talent Jam with the wider talent team.
#f-talent-general is the channel for everything talent: open roles, process questions, and experiments worth copying.

syncWith.name: Your client's lead
syncWith.why: owns the account and sets week-one priorities

syncWith.name: A talent partner on a neighboring client
syncWith.why: fastest way to absorb how pods actually run

finance.label: Finance
how: Finance and BizOps engagements run lean: usually one or two people embedded per client.
Deliverables live in the Base doc and Sheets templates from the hub. Everything client-facing follows the brand templates.
Weekly client syncs use the sync agenda template; keep a rolling doc per client.
When in doubt on scope or billing, ask your client lead before the client does.

syncWith.name: Your client's lead
syncWith.why: context on the engagement and what good looks like

syncWith.name: Eric Fernandez
syncWith.why: tools, systems and access for finance work

gtm.label: Go-to-market
how: GTM covers comms, content, growth, events and employer brand across clients.
Every deliverable should feel like the client's brand, not ours: start from their brand vault or site before writing a word.
Weekly cadence: a socials/content calendar per client, plus async Loom walkthroughs instead of extra meetings.
Share wins and launches in #g-amplify so the whole team can boost them.

syncWith.name: Your client's lead
syncWith.why: owns the narrative and the client relationship

syncWith.name: Gonz Sanchez
syncWith.why: runs several GTM engagements and knows the playbooks

other.label: Your team
how: Your manager will walk you through how your specific team runs in your day-one 1:1.
Default operating mode across Carrara: async first (Loom + Slack), briefs in the Base doc template, and Granola on every client call.
Read the Ways of Working page in Notion in week two: the four principles and what they look like in practice.

syncWith.name: Your client's lead
syncWith.why: context on the account you are joining

US.label: United States
notes: Payroll: Deel if you are a full-time employee, Bill.com if you are a US contractor. The invite comes to your email; ping Eric if it does not.
Send any tax paperwork (W-9 or equivalent) back the same week so your first payment is not delayed.
Holidays and time off follow the policy in the Time off section of this hub; post planned time off in #g-ooo.

AR.label: Argentina
notes: Payroll: international contractors run through Ramp. You will get an invite; invoice monthly in USD.
Ping Eric on Slack for the invoicing format and payment schedule before your first month closes.
Most client work runs on US hours: agree your overlap window with your manager in week one.
Post planned time off in #g-ooo, including local holidays you plan to take.

AU.label: Australia
notes: Payroll: international contractors run through Ramp. You will get an invite; invoice monthly in USD.
The timezone gap with the US is real: agree a standing overlap window with your manager and lean on async (Loom, Slack) for the rest.
Post planned time off in #g-ooo, including local holidays you plan to take.

OTHER.label: Your country
notes: Payroll: international contractors run through Ramp, full-time employees through Deel. Eric will confirm which applies to you.
Agree your overlap window with your manager in week one if your client runs on US hours.
